title: Sanlorenzo SL110A Asymmetric Yacht Poised for Cannes Premiere
description: Discover the Sanlorenzo SL110A, debuting at the Cannes Yachting Festival 2025. This yacht redefines space with its innovative asymmetrical design.
html:
Sanlorenzo SL110A: Groundbreaking Asymmetrical Layout Boosts Interior Space

Sanlorenzo will debut its newest 33-meter SL110A motor yacht at the upcoming Cannes Yachting Festival, taking place September 9-14, 2025. This addition to the shipyard’s asymmetrical range builds upon the SL102A and SL106A models. The SL110A incorporates innovative spatial concepts, offering a 15% gain in interior volume over traditional layouts by utilizing offset port and starboard gangways.

The SL110A is developed in collaboration with Zuccon International Project for exterior design and Piero Lissoni for interiors. The yacht achieves a top speed of 27 knots. Its asymmetrical hull shape expands living areas, enhances visibility, and allows natural light to flow unobstructed throughout the yacht.

Optimized Spaces and Key Amenities

At the bow, the SL110A replaces standard anchor gear with a built-in sea-facing terrace and a swimming pool. When the yacht is at rest, fold-down bulwarks increase the deck space by 8 square meters, while a rotating stern platform is designed for tender and jet ski stowage. The 45-square-meter full-beam master cabin has direct entry to the forward pool.

The main salon on the main deck features glass sliding doors that convert into a 22-square-meter platform beside the water. The flybridge can be set up for either lounging in the sun or alfresco dining. Removing 30% of the usual structural barriers allows for better views and delivers a total of 210 square meters of deck area.

Guest Comfort, Finishes, and Advanced Technology

The SL110A can host up to 10 guests in five cabins, including two staterooms with flexible twin or double arrangements. The yacht accommodates a crew of six across three cabins, which are paired with a separate crew mess. Interior decor includes Calacatta marble, resin-treated ceilings, and engineered wood panels throughout both guest and shared areas.

Technical highlights feature upgraded soundproofing for the engine spaces and refined stabilization systems for smoother cruising and better comfort at anchor.

Production Details and Market Placement

SL110A construction will remain at Sanlorenzo’s La Spezia shipyard. The vessel displayed at Cannes will be the initial launch in a run of six units scheduled for 2026. Starting price is €18 million, with extensive custom options available. The asymmetrical lineup now represents 40% of Sanlorenzo’s motor yacht order book, signaling strong demand for this revolutionary concept.

Sanlorenzo Overview

Sanlorenzo, founded in 1958 in Viareggio, is a premier yacht manufacturer building boats from 28.60 up to 73 meters. With each new release, the yard pushes forward in both engineering and design excellence.
